label: Assistant Reply
description: Single file attachment in an assistant reply. Best for a full width report card under a reply paragraph, with type and size and a secondary download button.

label: Composer Tray
description: Composer tray with removable attachments. Best for a message box topped by small chips that scroll sideways, a paperclip that adds files and a live attachment count.

label: Image Strip
description: Image cards in a snapping strip. Best for vertical image cards where a press marks one as chosen and prints its name and size below.

label: Three Sizes
description: Three sizes carrying three levels of an answer. Best for md, sm and xs chips stacked under labels to rank a deliverable, its working files and its sources.

label: Upload Queue
description: Upload queue across all five states. Best for each state on its own row, with a spinner while uploading, a retry on the failure and cancel on the upload.

label: File Picker
description: File picker that fills an attachment tray. Best for a dashed card that opens the system file picker, then lists the picks with image previews and a remove on each.
